name: portwhisk
title: Portwhisk
description: Manage SSH connections in Tinycast and open them in your preferred terminal.
author: chocoer

commands.name: connect
commands.title: Connect
commands.description: Search and connect to saved SSH servers.

commands.name: manage-connections
commands.title: Manage Connections
commands.description: Add, edit, and delete local SSH connections.

commands.name: terminal-settings
commands.title: Terminal Settings
commands.description: Choose the default terminal for SSH sessions.

scripts.build: ray build -e dist -o dist --non-interactive --exit-on-error && cp LICENSE dist/LICENSE
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package:release --
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.lint: eslint src tests scripts assets/*.js eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts assets/*.js .github/workflows package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit

preferences.name: language
preferences.title: Language / 语言
preferences.description: Interface language. Reopen the command after changing it. / 界面语言，修改后请重新打开命令。
